steps.action: Start the sub-assembly with the yellow 4x4 frame plate laid flat.
Place the trans-green 1x2 brick on the back-right edge of the frame, running front to back.
watch_for: The brick sits on the right side at the back corner, not the left.

steps.action: Add one lime 1x4 brick along the back edge and one along the front-right edge, leaving the left-front side open.
watch_for: The front brick covers the right side only, so the front-left studs stay exposed.
The back brick runs left to right, beside the trans-green brick.

steps.action: Lay the red 1x2 grille tiles on top of the lime bricks next to the trans-green brick.
watch_for: Keep the grille lines running the same direction as shown.

steps.action: Attach the dark gray 2x4 brick to the open front-left studs so it sticks out to the left.
watch_for: Only half of the brick sits on the frame; the rest overhangs to the left.
Check that it rests on the yellow plate level, not on top of the lime bricks.

steps.action: Cap the frame with the two red 1x4 tiles to close the square and add the light gray grille tiles on the back of the dark gray brick.
watch_for: Leave the front two studs of the dark gray brick uncovered.
Red tiles form a square around the trans-green brick opening.

steps.action: Press the finished sub-assembly into the middle of the blue body with the dark gray brick facing the front-left.
watch_for: Orient the gray brick end toward the front open side, not the gray slopes at the back.
